key_insight: Albilich is a steerable, stateful agent framework that combines LLM reasoning, CAS, retrieval, and persistence to make long-horizon mathematical research more reliable and reproducible.
engineering_relevance: The system shows how proof-state orchestration plus CAS integration can reduce token use and improve success on challenging symbolic reasoning tasks.
method: Long-horizon agentic proof search with advisor/verifier roles
CAS integration for symbolic computation and checking
SQLite-based persistent context plus literature retrieval
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 10/10 success on RealMath with CAS, 9/10 without CAS, and case studies on Kourovka Notebook problems including a counterexample and a strengthened proof.
watch_item: Results come from a limited set of benchmarks and case studies, so broader generalization and dependence on agent orchestration quality remain uncertain.
paper_title: Albilich: Steerable Proof-State Orchestration for LLM-Based Mathematical Research with CAS Integration
